name: Meta Los Lunas

timeline.event: Land clearing starts for new building.

Building 2 (a tent-like building) shell is complete, but we don't believe it's operational because there is unpaved ground, no cars parked right in front, the first tent buildings at Meta Prometheus took about 16 months (it's been 10 months
Building 2 (a tent like building) is operational. Based on a default estimate of 3 months for fit-out after structural completion in July.

explain: Meta Los Lunas is an operating AI data center in Los Lunas, NM, owned by meta. Epoch AI estimates it draws 118 MW today and 273 MW when finished.
